text_block_list.text:
One day, as I passed by the park, some 
food stalls were set up—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ngaaaaaah...!

In one corner of it, inside a yakisoba pan 
stall, Tamamo Cross was clutching her 
head.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Great timing. So, um... ya 
want one?

...And what she held out to me was a 
delicious-looking yakisoba pan.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ain't that the truth! Ah, no, I get it! My 
bad!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Um... you know that bakery lady from the 
shopping district who's always lookin' out 
for me?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
They give me stuff like bread crusts all 
the time for free, ya know. Saves me a 
whole bunch on food expenses...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
An' then that lady said she was runnin' a 
yakisoba pan stall, so I offered to help 
watch the shop to repay her. But—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...They didn't sell as well as I'd hoped. 
...*sigh*."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...No, that's not it! This is no time to 
be whining! I gotta do something!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Think, dammit! Show 'em that Naniwa 
merchant spirit, Tamamo Cross!

And so, Tamamo Cross pondered deeply for a 
while—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Nnn... Think, brain, think! A bargain idea 
that'll make folks wanna buy a ton—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ha!!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Got it!! It's an all-you-can-stuff 
cucumber sale!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All-you-can-stuff cucumbers is so fun! 
It's a great deal, and you can pack as 
many as you want!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Applying that principle— I can stuff as 
much yakisoba into this thing as I want!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If it's yakisoba, with my connections and 
know-how, I can arrange to get tons of it 
for cheap!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
An' with all-you-can-stuff, the 
customers'll be happy they can eat as much 
as they want, and it's a novelty that'll 
grab attention!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now that that's settled, I gotta 
check raw costs, balance the toppings with 
the noodles, and if it's 
all-you-can-stuff, I'll have to bump the 
price up a bit too—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, things are gonna get busy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as she planned, the bizarre project 
drew a huge crowd, and by sundown, 
everything was completely sold out!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Guess so. Times like this, you gotta 
make friends with the abacus.

Saying that, Tamamo Cross quietly began 
flicking the beads of the abacus.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So the cost price is that, utilities are 
'bout this much, and the unit price is 
that, so if we sell this many, the net 
profit'll be this much, and—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Gotta check the prices at the other shops 
too. Alright, I'm off on a little recon 
mission!

And so, after several dozen minutes of 
hectic running around...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Alright, done!

The price Tamamo Cross proposed turned out 
to be an incredible deal if you bought two 
as a set!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Lookin' at the customers comin' in for a 
while now, a surprisingly large number of 
'em are buyin' in multiples.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
They buy for their friends too, plus 
Umamusume customers usually eat a ton 
anyway!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
An' with this set price, if we sell our 
target amount, the revenue won't be bad at 
all!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"All that's left is bringin' in the 
customers! Let's do this!"

Afterward, Tamamo Cross's ringing sales 
pitch echoed through the air... and the 
yakisoba pan sold wonderfully!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Darn it! I can't think of a single good 
idea!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still, we're outta time... No choice then, 
gotta bring out my secret weapon...!

Tamamo Cross grabbed the price tag and 
slashed the price drastically.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It might be a bit tight, but if we clear 
80% we'll break even, and 90% cleared 
means a pretty decent profit!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
A merchant's done for the moment they 
chicken out! Gotta fire ourselves up!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, step right up, step right 
uuuup! Cheap, cheap, get it while it's 
cheap~!

After that, despite struggling a bit... we 
somehow managed to break even on sales!
